evidence_excerpts: The CUDA implementation takes about 4 milliseconds for distance, feature transform, and skeletonization on the same image, about 0.8 seconds per iteration for the graph in Figure 7a-b, and is reported as roughly 100 times faster than the CPU-based AFMM.
text: CUDA image-space distance transforms, skeletonization, path computation, and attraction make the skeleton-based edge bundling pipeline substantially faster than a CPU AFMM implementation on the tested graphs.
